metadata.description: Azure region for all resources. Defaults to the managed resource group region so data residency holds by construction.

Azure Container Registry name (without .azurecr.io) the platform images are pulled from. As scaffolded, the platform core (infra/bicep/modules/core.bicep) CREATES this ACR in the managed resource group, so it starts empty — the container images must be STAGED into it after creation (image-source/staging is the unresolved Phase-2 decision; see README TODO). It does NOT support a turnkey image pull today.
Image tag to deploy (usually the release tag).
Manage the state container time-based immutability (WORM) policy from IaC. Set false once the policy has been LOCKED out-of-band.

Entra auth mode for the deployed API. Phase-1 DELIVERED default is "disabled" (Option 3, issue #127) — safe ONLY because the API is internal-only (network-isolated, not publicly exposed). "required" (fail-closed) validates a bearer token on every request and is the hardening path; it MUST be enabled before exposing the API publicly. NOTE: ../bicep/main.bicep keeps its OWN default of "required" for direct deployers; this delivered wrapper defaults to "disabled".
Entra tenant (directory) id the API validates tokens against. Non-secret. Required (with authAudience) when authMode = required.
Expected API token audience (the API app registration Application ID URI / client id). Non-secret. Required (with authTenantId) when authMode = required.
Azure region
Azure Container Registry name (without .azurecr.io). Created by core.bicep.
Image tag to deploy (usually the release tag)

Manage (create/update) the state container time-based immutability (WORM) policy from IaC (issue #81). Set FALSE once the policy has been LOCKED out-of-band — Azure rejects any PUT on a LOCKED immutability policy, so leaving this true would break every subsequent deployment (core is always deployed).

Entra auth mode for the deployed API (issue #64). Fail-closed by default: "required" means the API validates a bearer token on every request and REFUSES TO SERVE unless authTenantId + authAudience are supplied. Set to "disabled" ONLY for a deliberate no-auth environment. Never a secret.

Entra tenant (directory) id the API validates tokens against, and the worker authenticates from (issue #64). Non-secret identifier. Empty by default — MUST be provided (with authAudience) for the fail-closed "required" default, or the API will refuse to serve.
Expected API token audience — the API app registration Application ID URI / client id (issue #64). Non-secret. Empty by default — MUST be provided (with authTenantId) for the "required" default.
Azure region
Short name prefix for resources
Resource token to keep names unique
Azure Container Registry name (alphanumeric, globally unique, without .azurecr.io)
Container Registry SKU
Storage queues the module KEDA triggers reference (mirrors src/modules/*/manifest.yaml).
Name of the durable state Blob container (mirrors WORKLOADS_STATE_CONTAINER, default "state").
Soft-delete retention (days) for blobs AND containers on the state account — window to recover a deleted/overwritten state artifact.
Time-based immutability (WORM) retention (days) on the state container — an artifact cannot be deleted/overwritten until this elapses. Unlocked so a human can extend/lock it out-of-band.

Manage (create/update) the state container time-based immutability (WORM) policy from IaC. Set FALSE once the policy has been LOCKED out-of-band — Azure rejects any PUT on a LOCKED immutability policy, so leaving this true would break every subsequent deployment (main.bicep always deploys core).
Short name prefix for resources (matches core.bicep)
Resource token to keep the globally-unique Grafana name stable per resource group
Resource id of the dedicated read-only Grafana user-assigned Managed Identity (from core.outputs.identityGrafanaId, issue #79)
Principal (object) id of that identity (from core.outputs.identityGrafanaPrincipalId) — the RBAC target
Name of the in-boundary Log Analytics workspace (from core.outputs.logAnalyticsName). Used to scope the Log Analytics Reader assignment to that single workspace — least privilege.
Grafana SKU. Standard is the only GA tier.
Public endpoint of the Managed Grafana instance (no secrets).
Short name prefix for resources (matches core.bicep)
Resource token to keep names stable per resource group
Resource id of the in-boundary Log Analytics workspace (from core.outputs.logAnalyticsId)
Name of the in-boundary Log Analytics workspace (from core.outputs.logAnalyticsName)
Principal (object) id of the worker Managed Identity that publishes telemetry (from core.outputs.identityWorkerPrincipalId, issue #79). It runs the telemetry_export Job.
Logs Ingestion endpoint URI of the Data Collection Endpoint (no secret). Feeds TELEMETRY_EXPORT_DCE_ENDPOINT.
Immutable id of the Data Collection Rule (no secret). Feeds TELEMETRY_EXPORT_DCR_IMMUTABLE_ID.
Module name, e.g. aiops
Container command override (e.g. the service entrypoint). Empty => use image default.
Storage account name backing keyless azure-queue KEDA scalers
azure-queue KEDA trigger: queue name ("" = none). queueLength uses KEDA default (5).
cpu KEDA trigger: target Utilization percent (0 = none)
http KEDA trigger: concurrent requests per replica (0 = none)
Extra env vars
Key Vault resource URI (e.g. https://<vault>.vault.azure.net) backing secretRefs. Empty => no Key Vault-backed secrets and no WP_KEY_VAULT_URI injected.

Key Vault-backed secrets to inject by identity (issue #85). Each item: { secretRefName, secretName, envVar } — a container secret named secretRefName sourced from keyVaultUri/secrets/secretName, surfaced to the app as env var envVar via secretRef. Never a plaintext value here.

Entra auth mode for the API (issue #64): "required" (fail-closed default — the API refuses to serve unless authTenantId + authAudience are set), or "disabled" (deliberate no-auth). Empty => not injected (only the API core needs it). Non-secret.
Entra tenant (directory) id the API validates tokens against (issue #64). Non-secret identifier. Empty => not injected.
Expected token audience — the API app registration Application ID URI / client id (issue #64). Non-secret. Empty => not injected.

Whether this app gets PUBLIC (external) Container Apps ingress. Only meaningful for the web app; the API is ALWAYS internal. review-67-v4 invariant: the public web front door is opened ONLY when the platform enforces required auth — main.bicep sets this to (authMode == required). Default false => internal-only (fail-closed, zero public surface).

variables.queueRules: [if(empty(parameters('queueName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', format('queue-{0}', parameters('queueName')), 'custom', createObject('type', 'azure-queue', 'identity', parameters('identityId'), 'metadata', createObject('accountName', parameters('storageName'), 'queueName', parameters('queueName'), 'cloud', 'AzurePublicCloud')))))]

configuration.ingress: [if(or(equals(parameters('moduleName'), 'api'), equals(parameters('moduleName'), 'web')), createObject('external', if(equals(parameters('moduleName'), 'web'), parameters('ingressExternal'), false()), 'targetPort', if(equals(parameters('moduleName'), 'api'), 8000, 80), 'transport', 'auto'), null())]

containers.name: [variables('resourceName')]
containers.env: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'AZURE_CLIENT_ID', 'value', parameters('identityClientId')), createObject('name', 'WP_MODULE', 'value', parameters('moduleName'))), variables('kvUriEnv'), variables('kvSecretEnv'), variables('authEnv'), parameters('envVars'))]

metadata.description: Module name, e.g. discovery
Event jobs: minimum concurrent executions. Not applicable to Schedule jobs.
Event jobs: maximum concurrent executions. For Schedule jobs this maps to ACA `parallelism` (replicas launched per scheduled run).
Trigger type: Schedule | Event | Manual
Native Schedule cronExpression (used when triggerType == Schedule)
Storage account name backing keyless azure-queue KEDA scalers
azure-queue KEDA trigger: queue name ("" = none). queueLength uses KEDA default (5).

Internal base URL of the API core (single writer) the worker reads state from and submits results to, e.g. https://wp-api.internal.<env>.azurecontainerapps.io. Threaded from the API container-app's internal ingress FQDN by main.bicep so it is correct by construction (never a hardcoded host).

Extra environment variables for this job's container (array of { name, value }). Used to thread module-specific, non-secret config (e.g. the telemetry_export DCE endpoint + DCR immutable id) without baking it into this generic template. Defaults to none.

Entra auth mode (issue #64): "required" => the worker mints a bearer for the API audience via its Managed Identity before submitting results; "disabled" => no token (local/dev). Empty => not injected. Non-secret.
Entra tenant (directory) id (issue #64). Non-secret. Empty => not injected. Required (with authAudience) when authMode=required so the worker can resolve the API scope.
Expected token audience — the API app registration Application ID URI / client id (issue #64); the worker requests <audience>/.default. Non-secret. Empty => not injected.

variables.queueRules: [if(empty(parameters('queueName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', format('queue-{0}', parameters('queueName')), 'type', 'azure-queue', 'identity', parameters('identityId'), 'metadata', createObject('accountName', parameters('storageName'), 'queueName', parameters('queueName'), 'cloud', 'AzurePublicCloud'))))]

configuration.eventTriggerConfig: [if(equals(parameters('triggerType'), 'Event'), createObject('parallelism', 1, 'replicaCompletionCount', 1, 'scale', createObject('minExecutions', parameters('minExecutions'), 'maxExecutions', parameters('maxExecutions'), 'rules', variables('scaleRules'))), null())]
